recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping nightly-sync so that any crash immediately emails a failure notice, recording a success timestamp when the job finishes cleanly, and adding a Synology Task Scheduler check (no Docker) that alerts the user if that success mark is missing by about 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you want to know by morning if nightly-sync did not succeed, with no logs to read.
labels.Deleted: central log on Synology, Dockerizing the job, Pieter Levels style dashboard.
labels.Bottleneck: a missing success email went unnoticed for four days, not a lack of stored logs.
labels.Checked myself: cron at 03:00 on edna, email only on finish, token crash before email, no other alert, Synology available.

note: It rejects central logging and Docker but recommends two separate alert paths (an immediate crash email and a self-hosted missing-success check on the Synology), which makes it LARGER rather than a single alert.
